Rooted in Family.
Grown for Generations.
Eau Galle Grain Company is a family-owned and operated business. We offer grain handling solutions to area farmers using the expertise and knowledge we have gained over 3 generations on the farm.
Three Generations.
One Legacy.
Founded in 1965, Mellenthin Farms is a family-owned operation that spans five counties in western Wisconsin. Led today by Marty and Tony Mellenthin, we carry forward a deep-rooted commitment to stewardship, efficiency and doing things the right way.
More About Us
What We Grow
We specialize in soybeans and corn — from commodity to identity-preserved, non-GMO varieties grown for specialty markets. With modern equipment, data-driven crop management, and decades of experience, every acre is cared for with precision and purpose.
Explore Our Farm
Track Our Grain Prices
View current cash bids for our soybean and corn offerings through our live DTN feed. We update this regularly to ensure buyers have real-time access to market information.
View Cash Bids
Drying Charges & Discounts
We’re a family-owned Eau Galle elevator proudly serving local farmers with fair, transparent rates for corn and soybeans. Our straightforward drying charges and discount schedules mean no surprises — just honest pricing, quality handling and neighborly service you can trust season after season.
